_readme: Every line Panda says in the two rooms: the bedroom (/room.html) and the living room (Home, /living-room.html).
Edit freely; the pages read this file on load (no build step). Keys starting with _ are notes and are ignored.
Keep each line <= 96 characters (two dialog-box lines; longer ones log a warning in the browser console).
Use straight quotes: the PC-98 font draws curly ones full-width.
Doors (door_bedroom, door_outside) only have hover lines: clicking a door goes straight through it.
greeting: the opening box. hover: the line on pointing at an object. click: the box on first opening it this visit;
repeat: on opening it again. lines (on an object): what a no-link object says. choices: the menu after click
(label, and href or copy). lines (on a room): idle (after a while with no input), empty (clicking nothing), replies.
Living room only, for live state (the house's real devices): a variant per state, chosen by the page:
lamps: hover_on / hover_off / hover_unknown (feed down); lines, or lines_on / lines_off. {brightness} (percent),
{kelvin}, {warmth} (warm / soft white / daylight) fill in when the lamp is on.

tv: hover_off / hover_on (an idle screen) / hover_playing / hover_unknown; lines, lines_playing. While something plays, hover_episode ({show}, {episode}) or hover_show ({show}) when the app says what it is, else hover_playing.

speakers: hover_playing / hover_quiet / hover_unknown; lines, lines_playing. While music plays, hover_track ({title}, {artist}) or hover_title ({title}) when the app says what it is, else hover_playing.
kotatsu: hover_on / hover_off / hover_unknown (its plug); lines, lines_on.
thermostat: hover and lines may use {temp} (F), {heat} (on/off), {humidity}; hover_unknown when there's no reading.
blinds: hover_open / hover_partial / hover_closed / hover_unknown; {pct} (percent open) in hover_partial.
ac: hover_on ({mode}, {temp} its setpoint °F, {fan}) / hover_on_notemp / hover_off / hover_unknown; lines, lines_on.
Bedroom lines are adapted visual-novel lines; their sources: pc98-assets/assets/panda-room/dialogue-sources.md.

_readme: Panda's spare key (js/house-key.js): found through Explore (Johnny's hunt) or the bedroom PC's login.
Holding it, a visitor can switch the living room's lamps, blinds and AC (not the TV, kotatsu, bedroom lamp or music).
{item} is an item's name, {word} the word written on it, {left} how many favours are still owed.
The four words themselves are in js/house-key.js (ITEMS); the server checks them (scripts/house_key.py set-hunt).
house_key.slot_empty: My spare key's hidden somewhere in town. Friends only.
house_key.slot_key: My spare key. Make yourself at home: the lamps, the blinds and the AC are yours.
house_key.pickup: You found my spare key! Make yourself at home.

job: "Ah, the spare key. A fine piece of information, stranger, and not one I part with cheaply."
"Four souls in this town owe Panda a favour. Collect all four, and I'll tell you where it lies."
names: "Sabrina at Rabu Rabu. Brownie at the bathhouse.
The attendant on Platform 1. And Andy, if he'll give you the time."

done: "Every debt collected. A pleasure doing business, stranger.
What you seek lies beneath the water in the Hidden Glade."
